source: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
cautions: Does not establish occurrence or nativity in Hays County
Historic taxonomy and measurements must be checked before use in identification scoring

Flora key p.651: young stems glabrous except on angles; 2–4(–5) pinna pairs; 10 stamens; conspicuously hairy stipules; flattened petiolar gland wider than petiole; sickle-shaped fruits; red cylindrical or turnip-shaped taproot.
Flora p.652 recognizes species separately from Desmanthus virgatus var. acuminatus, following Luckow (1993).
